detail.title: Digital Food Measuring Spoon Scale - Grey
detail.overview: The Ant AEKSS10 is a digital measuring spoon scale that combines a scoop and precision scale in one compact tool, weighing solids, liquids and powders up to 300g for accurate portion control in the kitchen. It supports 3 measurement units (grams, ounces, millilitres) with a tare function and an easy-to-read LCD screen, making it simple to zero out a container before adding ingredients. A detachable scoop design allows fast, thorough cleaning after each use, while a practical hanging loop keeps it neatly stored and within reach in any kitchen drawer or hook. Auto shut-off after 60 seconds of standby conserves battery, making the AEKSS10 a genuinely handy tool for home cooks, bakers, chefs, coffee brewers and even pet owners measuring food portions.
